{{recipe}}

This is the Thai version of '''lemonade'''.

==Ingredients==
* 125 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] water
* 100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 stalks [[Cookbook:Lemongrass|lemongrass]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] piece of [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]], peeled and cut into pieces
* 1 [[Cookbook:Liter|liter]] [[Cookbook:Carbonated Water|carbonated water]]
* [[Cookbook:Lime|Lime]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]], for [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]]

==Procedure==
#Bring the water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] with the sugar, lemon grass, and ginger. Boil for 20 minutes.
#Allow the syrup to cool, then remove lemongrass and ginger.
# Pour the syrup in 4 large glasses, and add the carbonated water.
# Garnish glasses with lime discs.
